title: Donkey Kong Bananza (DKB Recomp)
description: Static recompilation of Donkey Kong Bananza (Switch 2) to native Windows and Linux with Vulkan. 0.5.1 out: NVIDIA shader cache fix, player 2 rumble; one-file Windows launcher, presets, local co-op, 16:10, Thai. Requirements: docs/requirements.md. Roadmap: #10. No game files included.
